messages:
greenwave-cs: Hey team — after your maintenance window (~22:40 UTC) our inbound webhooks from Redwood started getting blocked by our firewall. We whitelist the 3 IPs you provided during onboarding. Latest attempts show source IP 34.210.45.77 which isn't on our allowlist and is being rejected with 403. Can you confirm your egress IPs?

maria (Support): Hi — sorry for the disruption. You're on a Private/VPC deployment, correct? Can you share a sample request-id and the approximate timestamp so we can trace it? I'll ping the infra folks.

greenwave-cs: Yes private VPC. Sample: request-id rdw-req-9f8a at 2028-11-07T22:43:12Z. From our bastion: `curl -v https://hooks.greenwave.example` shows TCP reset and firewall logs show DROP from 34.210.45.77. Traceroute shows first hop out of our VPC then that IP.

maria (Support): Thanks — @alex can you check the NAT/egress mapping for gw-prod-93? Customer says the source IP doesn't match their whitelist.

alex (SRE): Looking now. No planned maintenance in public calendar, but I do see autoscaler activity on the NAT autoscale group at ~22:41 UTC. The autoscaler rebalanced SNAT hosts and a subset of VPCs were moved to a different NAT host that uses 34.210.45.0/27. Customer previously had egress in 34.210.32.x range. That would explain the new source IP.

ingrid (Networking): Confirmed on our side — the pool rebalancer moved gw-prod-93 to a different NAT instance in eu-west-1b due to host pressure. Their current egress NAT address is 34.210.45.77.

maria (Support): Ok. Two immediate options: 1) add the new IP (34.210.45.77) to your allowlist so webhooks are unblocked now, or 2) we can provision a reserved/static egress IP for your VPC (requires a reserved SNAT binding and small config change). Which do you prefer?

greenwave-cs: We need a stable solution — adding an IP is temporary. We asked for static egress during onboarding; did that not complete?

samir (Platform): It looks like the static egress reservation didn't fully complete during onboarding due to a race in the provisioning flow. There's an open ticket that never applied the reservation. I'll escalate. @maria I need the org id to patch immediately.

maria (Support): Org id is gw-prod-93. Greenwave, short-term we'll ask security to allowlist 34.210.45.77 so you can resume traffic. Long-term we'll complete the static egress reservation and set an autoscaler exclude flag so your VPC won't move between NAT hosts.

greenwave-cs: Please do that. Also our security team wants a short signed statement that this was caused by an internal NAT reassign and not anything misconfigured on our side.

alex (SRE): I'll write the incident note. For faster mitigation I can push a sticky SNAT binding for this VPC (low-risk control-plane change) which should seal the egress IP within ~30 minutes. Requesting approval from on-call.

oncall-bot: Incident approval requested by alex. Reply with :approve: or :deny: to proceed.

ingrid (Networking): Approving. Applying sticky SNAT bind for gw-prod-93 now and setting autoscaler exclude flag.

maria (Support): Greenwave — we've applied a temporary allowlist entry on your behalf and initiated a sticky SNAT bind. Can you confirm webhooks are flowing?

greenwave-cs: Confirmed — webhooks resumed at 22:57 UTC. Thanks for the quick help. We'll keep the new IP in our allowlist until you confirm the permanent reservation.

samir (Platform): Created infra ticket INF-2028-432 to finish the reservation and added a postmortem to the onboarding flow to catch incomplete SNAT reservations. Also adding a doc note: "If you require stable egress, confirm the 'static-egress' checkbox AND ensure the reservation ticket transitions to CLOSED."

maria (Support): I'll open a support ticket and send a short incident summary plus the signed note for your security team.

greenwave-cs: Appreciate it — please loop us when the permanent reservation is complete.

(ended)
